symbols.name: LuxonDateTimeTransformer
symbols.sig: const LuxonDateTimeTransformer: ValueTransformer = { to(value: DateTime | null | undefined): Date | null { if (!value) return null; return value.toJSDate(); }, …

members.name: createdAt
decos: @Column({ type: "timestamp with time zone", name: "createdAt", default: () => "CURRENT_TIMESTAMP", transformer: LuxonDateTimeTransformer, })

members.name: content
doc: Rich-text body as sanitized HTML, with the formatting preserved for display.

members.name: contentText
doc: Plain-text projection of `content` (HTML stripped): what I embed and run literal search on, so the AI never sees markup.

members.name: embedding
mods: @Column({ type: "vector", nullable: true, select: false } as any)
doc: Vector embedding for the Omnibar semantic search (768-dim, Gemini). I set select:false so normal queries do not drag the vector across the wire; the search SQL selects it explicitly.
